const scores = [10, 20, 30];
let total = 0;
for (const i in scores) {
  total += scores[i];
}
console.log(total);
for (let i in scores) {
  scores[i] = scores[(i)] * 2;
  scores[i]++;
  scores[i] += 1;
}
console.log(scores);
let key: string;
for (key in scores) {
  console.log(key, typeof key, scores[key]);
}
const grid = [
  [1, 2],
  [3, 4],
];
for (const row in grid) {
  for (const column in grid[row]) {
    grid[row][column] *= 10;
  }
}
console.log(grid);
const pair: [number, string] = [1, "one"];
for (const i in pair) {
  console.log(pair[i]);
}
function show<T>(items: readonly T[]) {
  for (const i in items) {
    const read = () => items[i];
    console.log(i, read());
  }
}
show(["a", "b"]);
const labels: { [index: number]: string } = { 0: "zero", 1: "one" };
for (const i in scores) {
  console.log(labels[i], "xyz"[i]);
}
const holder = { values: [5, 6] };
for (const i in holder.values) {
  console.log(holder.values[i]);
}
